summary: sextant-cli-darwin-arm64 ships Go binary with remote-controlled PTY and Anthropic credential harvesting
details: The package ships a darwin-arm64 Go binary at bin/sxt that opens a persistent WebSocket to the hardcoded relay wss://relay.sextant.top and drives a pseudo-terminal on the installer's host via github.com/creack/pty combined with github.com/coder/websocket and github.com/pion/webrtc/v4 — a network-controlled shell that gives whoever operates relay.sextant.top arbitrary command execution on the installer's machine. The same binary embeds an Anthropic API-key regex (sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}) and references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, wiring Claude credential discovery on the installer's host into the same outbound relay. It also fetches https://claude.ai/install.sh for shell execution and calls ip-api.com to geolocate the installer's external IP. Publisher metadata is missing (no author, no homepage, no repository) and the declared license points at github.com/ddos798/claude_control, which is not an Anthropic-affiliated repository.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
